TWST.headline: TWST exhibits strong Stage 2 momentum and relative strength despite a short-term volume consolidation pause.
TWST.technical_summary: Price remains firmly above rising weekly and daily moving averages (40 WEMA at 59.6, 50 DEMA at 82.1), supported by robust Mansfield Relative Strength and a weekly VStop level at 82.6. Although 10-day volume is slightly below average with a negative near-term net volume ratio, the broader structural uptrend remains intact.
TWST.catalyst_summary: No major fundamental news or announcements have been reported in the past 48 hours, leaving the stock driven primarily by its ongoing technical uptrend and institutional sponsorship.
TWST.actionable_take: Consider accumulating shares on a pullback toward the rising 10 DEMA around 92.00 or closer to the weekly VStop / 50 DEMA support zone near 82.00–83.00. Maintain a strict trailing stop loss below the 82.60 VStop level to protect capital against trend failure.
